title: Very small candles for price
text: Very small candles for price. While this candle smells lovely, it arrived very small. The photo makes them appear quite large, they are not. I would not have spent this much on such a small candle.

product_metadata.title: Bluecorn Botanica Beeswax Pillar Candle Scented with Eucalyptus & Orange Essential Oils - 3" x 6"
features: These handmade, pure beeswax candles celebrate the alchemy of bee and blossom with the addition of subtle, pure essential oil blends for scent and aromatherapy.
Bluecorn Botanica beeswax pillar candles are always free from paraffin, soy, phthalates and metal-core wicks. These candles are non-toxic and clean-burning.
Burn 2" pillars for a maximum of 90 min a burn. 3" pillars should be burned for at least 3 hours at a time. Always burn pillar candles on a heat-resistant surface like a pillar base or plate.
Average full candle burn times: 2"x4.5" = 36 hrs ; 3"x4" = 60 hrs; 3"x6" = 90 hrs.
description: Our Lightly Filtered Beeswax is sweetly aromatic on its own. With this in mind, we have chosen essential oils which blend seamlessly into this luxurious base to create unusual and inspiring scents. Each one evoking a feeling, carrying a mood and gently shifting our awareness.
